description: This file defines an interface 'OnSizeChangedListener' used to handle size change events for list items in an Android app, specifically updating data when a layout changes size.

classes.name: OnSizeChangedListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to size change events in list items, with a method 'onSizeChanged' that is invoked when the size changes.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Callback method invoked with the new height when a size change occurs.
